import re
import sys

text = sys.stdin.read()
values = {}

pattern = re.compile(
    r"\b(TMP|[a-p])\s*<-\s*"
    r"(?:\(\s*\1\s*\+\s*(\d+)\s*\)\s*mod\s*100|(\d+))\b"
)

for match in pattern.finditer(text):
    name, increment, initial = match.groups()
    if initial is not None:
        values[name] = int(initial)
    else:
        values[name] = (values[name] + int(increment)) % 100

names = [*map(chr, range(ord("a"), ord("p") + 1)), "TMP"]
print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]}" for name in names) + ";")
